review.scope: Source analytic proofs and reported independent implementation checks carried without Capital reproof/replay. Prior P1 transfer holds bind original report/code/results/audits.

title: Remove output condition-number dependence from the relative-perturbation N675 entropy filter
statement: Under relative input domination and a known positive output SLD gap,the source finite resolvent filter gives faithful state pairs with a computable positive Umegaki entropy gap using constants depending on h,d0,not an output condition-number bound.

evidence.range_scope: Relative-domination/known-SLD-gap finite filter,uniform quadrature/log-derivative estimates and operational per-history limitation.

requires: -h*rho<=H<=h*rho and g^S_Q(rho)(Q(H))-g^S_P(rho)(P(H))>=d0>0,with known h,d0 and the governing finite N675 filter/distribution nu_m. Preserve the actual normalized source bounds and source-specific construction.
For the log-derivative estimate use positive S on its support,Hermitian Y with -qS<=Y<=qS. No commutation or arbitrary output eigenvalue-ratio bound is assumed.
provides: Uniformly for positive a,b, |(a+b)*integral nu_m(dt)/(b+a*t)-1|<=3sqrt(2/m),using |(a+b)/(b+a*t)-1|<=|1-t|/t and reciprocal beta-prime comparison symmetry.

For k>=2,||d^k/dt^k log(S+tY)|_0||<=k!*q^k. The source combines these estimates into explicit rational filter size,faithful mixing,perturbation amplitude and final margin depending only on h,d0. Full construction constants are in the unacquired report.
assumptions: This removes an EXTRA conversion conditioning dependence. It neither replaces N675 dimension-independent scaled source bounds by arbitrary Phi(I) nor reopens standing N675 acceptance.
A finite filtered witness for each conditional state does not show that one fixed physically paid sequential encoder realizes all such witnesses.
costs: Finite flags,mixing andperturbation are real source operations. Their computable dependence on h,d0 does not prove the missing conditioned history density or a universal ordinary capacity rate.
contract.units: SLD/BKM/relative entropy retain source logarithm conventions;positive finite margins andfilter flags.
contract.obstruction: The operational fixed-encoder/history realization and positive ordinary-rate premise remain unresolved.

body: Source reports two collaborators independently checking estimates andmargin accounting. Original proof/code/check records remain held;Capital does not rerun them.
